reviewNote: Reviewed the complete one-row Lexicon asset after tracing both installed 1.6.15 call sites and rereading all four dependent Pierre/Willy purchase greetings. The game splits this localized key on bare caret, keeps the first branch for a male player, selects the second for a female player, and inserts the result as the direct-address {0}; farmáři^farmářko preserves the locked farmář glossary identity and supplies the correct Czech vocative for both player genders.

rows.structureReason: Installed Stardew Valley 1.6.15 IL loads this localized key in both purchased-item dialogue methods, splits it on a bare caret, defaults to index 0, and selects index 1 for a female player. The two resulting values are passed as {0} to the greeting 'Hey, {0}.', so Czech intentionally adds the runtime-supported male/female vocative branch farmáři^farmářko.
